title: Connector status document
description: The document published to a connector's status subject (D-5) and returned verbatim by its admin surface's `status` endpoint (D-8). See status.md for field-by-field prose.

contract.description: The contract version this status document implements (D-1).

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the current state. Empty string when state needs no explanation (e.g. running); always present as a key, per D-14's absence-vs-empty-value distinction — an empty reason is a value ("nothing to report"), not the field being left out.

since.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent state transition.

cursor.description: Lag reporting (D-7). Null for a connector with no cursor concept (e.g. a sink). An object may report behind_ms, backfill, both, or neither, depending on connector phase.

behind_ms.description: CDC lag: source-time delta in milliseconds. The one canonical lag number for a connector currently tailing changes. Never negative — a connector cannot be ahead of its own source.

backfill.description: Backfill progress. Deliberately has no percentage/denominator field (D-7) — one does not exist in general.

copied.description: Count of items copied so far. Never negative — a count has no meaningful negative value.

done.description: Whether the backfill phase has completed.

counters.description: Free-form named counters (e.g. published, errors). Null when the connector has none to report.

admin.description: The connector's admin surface root subject (D-8), e.g. $CONNECTOR.<namespace>.admin.<instanceID>.

connector_id.description: Runtime identity (D-3): the durable connector id, or its fallback.

workload_id.description: Runtime identity (D-3): the ephemeral workload id, when the launcher provides one.
